def build_grid(dirs):
    # dirs maps colors to 'U' or 'D'; translate each object's tight bounding box to that edge.
    shapes={
      3:[(4,0),(4,1),(5,1),(6,1),(7,1)],
      6:[(5,8),(6,5),(6,6),(6,7),(7,5),(7,6),(7,7),(8,5),(8,6),(8,7),(9,4)],
      4:[(11,c) for c in range(11,16)]+[(12,13),(13,13)],
      7:[(17,4),(18,4),(19,2),(19,3),(19,4),(20,4),(21,4)]}
    out=[[0]*19 for _ in range(28)]
    for color, cells in shapes.items():
        r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
        target0=0 if dirs[color]=='U' else 28-(r1-r0+1)
        for r,c in cells:
            rr=target0+(r-r0)
            assert out[rr][c]==0, (color,rr,c,out[rr][c])
            out[rr][c]=color
    assert all(len(row)==19 for row in out)
    return out
